key_impacts: Earthquake triggered a tsunami and a Fukushima nuclear meltdown in a cascading disaster.
Tsunami flooded more than 200 square miles across coastal cities.
evidence_snippets: Great Eastern Earthquake triggered a tsunami and Fukushima nuclear meltdown that devastated northern Japan on March 11, 2011.
The tsunami flooded more than 200 square miles across cities along Japan’s coastline.
missing_information: Exact impacted cities beyond Fukushima are not specified.
Casualty and economic loss figures are not provided.
Duration and detailed timeline of impacts are not described.
